what: A48 canary: cascade-theory premises (flush-vacuity + W1.2 blocking dichotomy + blocker taxonomy) checked against all 36 A37 critical-point atlas entries, with a sign-flip corruption gate.  Empirical, float64, never an input to a certified verdict.
conventions: Certificate: ONE FJ multiplier vector at lambda0 = 1 -- the min-sum-lambda HiGHS vertex of A^T lambda = e_s, 0 <= lambda <= 1e6 on the A44 Fact-0 physical row set (expanded row set as fallback where the physical set is infeasible: the two VALLEY-MARGINAL entries).  W1.2 is per-certificate, so LOADED means lambda_k > 1e-7 in THIS vector, not "loadable".

Force direction ON square a: wall row -> inward wall normal; a-corner-on-j-edge (resting) -> j's outward edge normal (points into a); other-corner-on-a-edge (received) -> MINUS a's outward edge normal.  Identical to grad_{c_a} g_k, which is how it is cross-checked (tau_geo vs tau_grad).
tau_k = cross(p_k - q, n_k); the row (a,b) itself has p = q so tau = 0 (reported as max_self_tau).
Flushness is decided by the A44 Fact-0 row count (2 rows = segment contact = flush); the A46 task-1 geometric label is computed independently and the agreement is reported.
A flush edge contributes its TWO contact points as two rows, each with its own tau.

vacuity.statement: every genuine entry carries >= 1 flush contact, so the flush-free hypothesis of every A48 statement is VACUOUS on all 36 atlas entries (the 24 NOT-CP entries are vacuous for a second, independent reason: they are not critical points).

negative_control.perturbation: n_k negated on RECEIVED rows (another body's corner resting on a's edge) only; everything else identical.

blocker_tally.note: blocker rows (tau > tol) found at loaded CE/WC rows; role rest = a's corner pushing on a partner edge, recv = a partner corner pushing on a's edge, rest_wall = a container wall.

pencil_support.note: for every loaded CE/WC row landing in the W1.2 PENCIL branch, the multiset of the OTHER loaded rows at the corner square a (all of which have tau = 0).

a46_audit_agreement.note: A46 counts non-rattler-incident CONTACTS; A48 counts kept contact EDGES -- the same objects. Flushness in A48 is decided by the A44 Fact-0 row count, in A46 by the geometric FL/WF test; they agree edge-for-edge (see a46_label_agreement per entry).
